PluginData.Tooltip: Turns what your ore detector sees into GPS markers you can keep, sort and come back to.
PluginData.Description:
Server-friendly ore scouting: turns what your ore detector can see into GPS markers you can keep, sort and come back to.
Every scan starts at a working ore detector block and reaches only as far as that detector's own range, so it shows nothing the vanilla ore detector couldn't already reveal. Its markers carry a hidden tag, so OreScout only ever changes markers it made itself; your own GPS points are never touched.
Use it from an ore detector's toolbar actions.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineers/tree/main/Projects/OreScout
